verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Atlanta and describes its style as contemporary Southern luxury.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in the heart of downtown, The Ritz-Carlton, Atlanta embodies contemporary Southern luxury.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is an exclusive hotel partner of the Georgia Aquarium, and guests enjoy special access to it.
verified_facts.excerpt: As an exclusive hotel partner of the Georgia Aquarium, guests enjoy special access to one of the city’s most iconic destinations.

verified_facts.text: AG, Modern Bar and Steakhouse has leather-clad booths lined with vintage photographs and an al fresco Veranda.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dine at this steakhouse in downtown Atlanta in rich leather-clad booths lined with vintage photographs or al fresco on the Veranda.

verified_facts.text: AG offers three private dining spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: AG offers three distinctive private dining spaces, each providing a unique experience for your next intimate gathering.

verified_facts.text: AG has a table called the Hideout, set in a secluded corner with a privacy curtain and a leather booth.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in a secluded corner, this exclusive table offers a level of intimacy that is unmatched with a privacy curtain and cozy leather booth.

verified_facts.text: Lumen Lounge offers live entertainment on select evenings alongside mixology and globally inspired cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: complemented by masterfully crafted mixology and live entertainment on select evenings.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge is on the 24th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: We invite you to The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge in Atlanta to experience luxury redefined on the 24th floor.

verified_facts.text: The Club Lounge hosts guided bourbon tastings.
verified_facts.excerpt: from a curated collection of vintage photography to guided bourbon tastings in the Club Lounge.

verified_facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

verified_facts.text: Wellness Level guestrooms have PURE air purification.
verified_facts.excerpt: PURE air purification, promotes improved sleep and clearer breathing.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has TechnoGym equipment and Peloton bikes with live-streaming classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: state-of-the-art weight and cardio equipment from TechnoGym or take your workout to the next level with live-streaming classes on a Peloton bike.

verified_facts.text: The hotel runs a Ritz Kids program for young guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Atlanta welcomes young guests with a Ritz Kids program designed to channel children’s natural curiosity into experiences.

verified_facts.text: In-Room Camping includes a premium tent, a plush sleeping bag, a flashlight, a book and a stuffed animal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bring the outdoors inside with In-Room Camping, which includes a premium tent, plush sleeping bag, flashlight, book, stuffed animal, and full setup for a magical night of adventure.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the guests as business travelers during the week and families on the weekends.
